title: Method A Narrow Crack-Following Selective Adaptive Remeshing Optimization
scientific_objective: Develop and validate a computationally efficient, narrow, crack-following adaptive mesh for the Mode-I off-axis hole benchmark using existing MISESERI fields and Abaqus native remeshing tools. Improve spatial selectivity while retaining sufficient resolution of both crack branches, without prescribing known crack coordinates.
stages: Stage A: Establish Baseline & Quantitative Sizing Metrics
Stage B: Investigate Selective Error Aggregation & Spatial Marking
Stage C: Generate Candidate Adapted Meshes via Abaqus CAE
Stage D: Select & Scientifically Validate the Strongest Mesh
